articles.title: A Famous Writer's Old Amber Rocks Just Spilled a 40-Million-Year-Old Secret!
articles.summary: Scientists used X-ray super-scans to peek inside amber that once belonged to writer Goethe. They found three ancient bugs, including an ant so perfectly preserved they could see its tiny hairs!

articles.title: A Giant Hidden Fan Under Antarctica's Ice Is Changing What We Know!
articles.summary: Scientists found a huge, fan-shaped pattern of deep basins buried under miles of Antarctic ice. It connects famous spots like Lake Vostok and may control how ice moves today.

articles.title: A New Pill Just Doubled Survival for a Really Tough Cancer!
articles.summary: Pancreatic cancer is super deadly, but a new drug called daraxonrasib targets its main genetic switch. In a big trial, it nearly doubled how long patients lived.
